defect: Reusable administrator PAT was exposed to manual workflows that execute mutable repository code.

remediation.trigger: first push of this exact file to main
actions: delete FAR_GITHUB_ADMIN_TOKEN as the final API operation
emit deletion receipt or use credentialless recovery on rerun
remediation.recovery: If the secret is absent, read-only operations using GITHUB_TOKEN must observe both workflows disabled and public main metadata protected with merge-authority enforced for everyone.
